- When sentiment is strongly positive (e.g., >0.66) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; adjust forecast downward by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- Model consistently underestimates prices after recent spikes (e.g., >70) — apply upward bias of 2–5% for 3–7 days post-spike.  
- If sentiment is negative and price is falling, model often underreacts — add 0.5–1.5% upward bias to prevent premature bottoming.  
- Model shows persistent lag in capturing mean reversion — if 3–5 consecutive days show price below 65, apply upward correction of 1–2% per day until price stabilizes.  
- For 30-day forecasts, model tends to underestimate the final 5–7 days — increase final 5–7 forecast values by 1–3% to align with observed trend acceleration.
